text: good app, but i would like a duplicate button for routines. I work at different hours and different from week to week. I want a reminder if I am working and don't want a reminder when I am not working. maybe I am not used to the app yet, either way, I feel hopeful about it.
author: Lina Holmberg Nilsson

text: It's a really good app, and it helped me with my morning routine. But if I choose to get help with the morning routine, then I don't get help with the evening routine without paying. I still like the app, but that's unfortunate. Also, there are times when I pause cos of a distraction to my routine, then absentmindedly press the check button to resume, skipping over a whole routine. It would be nice if you made it harder to press the it before the time runs out, a quick "Are u sure?" Thanks ^^
author: Kentu Buchi

text: This app is amazing, it has a ton of features but is at the same time super easy to understand. I've found a couple bugs, but that is to be expected as the developer is a team of just one person and the app is relatively new. I really like it so far!
author: Hannes Lindholm

text: Helps me getting started on the tasks, reminds me of what's next.
author: Minna Keskitalo

text: As someone with both ADD and autism this app seems like a great way to promote healthy habits/routines while allowing me to relax.
author: Alexander Tarler

text: Den var bra, men kunde inte ställa mer en 1 rutin,det var dyrt och lite tillgängligt
author: Caroline Kavander

text: Wish there was an option for every other/third week, et.c. Otherwise a fantastic app! Great for my adhd! Easy, fun and it motivats me to get things done. Works amazingly 👏
author: Therese Olaisen

text: Det går inte att lägga rutiner varannan vecka, finns inte ljud att välja och helt omöjligt att säga upp efter Trial time. Tried to reach them but completely impossible.
author: Carina Pernelid

text: so far so good! 😊
author: Sophie Kuiper

text: för jag har mer tid nu att göra saker och jag känner mig bättre
author: Nicole Qirko

text: Underbart verktyg! Så smidig och den hjälper mig att skapa hållbara rutiner. Nu slipper jag att ha allt i huvudet, utan kan istället klicka mig fram steg för steg i mina morgon- och kvällsrutiner. Kommer snart fylla på med fler rutiner. Detta hjälper mig att "få ordning på livet". SÅ värt pengarna! Tack!
author: Christina Lindqvist

text: Tycker appen är väldigt bra för mig som behöver en tydlig morgon och kvällsrutin. Där jag håller fokus och inte fastnar i andra uppgifter, och jag kommer ihåg allt jag ska göra :) Gillar att man kan använda sig av emoji, men hade önskat att man kunde använda egna foton/att det fanns mer bilder att välja mellan.
author: Andréa

text: I love this app! It really helps me stay on track while doing my routines. Great for adhd!
author: Sara Hassanvan

text: Bästa appen för att komma ut på "banan" igen!!
author: Boel Eriksson

text: Lätt att lägga till egna rutiner, existerande bra val på vilka rutiner en kan behöva. Enkelt interface 👍
author: Caroline Lundberg

text: Appen gör det mycket lättare för mig att hålla koll på mina dagliga rutiner för både hushållet och min hälsa. Jag är i vanliga fall en mästare på att procrastinera men än så länge är detta som ett nytt liv. Jag återkommer med ny recension längre fram.
author: Emelie Kallin

text: Precis vad jag letat efter. Tror denna kan hjälpa mig vidare mot förändrade och uppgraderade rutiner som verkligen gör skillnad.
author: Daniel Segerfast

text: (Update: works perfectly now, thank you!) The app has only served me well and is effective!:) But around 2days ago it has begun glitching every time I use it and it's very frustrating. When I begin a routine it jumps out of it when I leave the app and I have to restart the routine every time I want to update a step in the routine. How to solve?
author: Linn Lonnerholm
developer_reply: Thanks for letting me know! Have fixed it and will release the update today. Sorry for the inconvenience.

author: Magnus Mellqvist

text: While there are certain features I wish was added, the app itself is brilliant and I've been using it every day for a week to uphold a morning, evening, and study routine. Highly recommended!:)
author: Lisa Hiselius

text: from what I've seen so far 👍👍👍
author: Elis Grahn

text: I've been looking for something like this for quite a while. Really good attempt, but too inexplicable and uninformative. Apparently, because it would not save more than 3 routines, purchase of something is necessary, but I see no info on how, how much or what. This app is made for neurodivergents who demand accuracy, brevity and clarity. Not good enough yet for me to be convinced. Getting bored rather quickly from the strange and limited choices of emojis.
author: Amema Bastet

text: good concept but a couple of things don't work. when pausing a step it restarts randomly again on it's own, the App reminds you to start your routine even if you are currently doping your routine, sometines when you go to the mest step the timer is already doping overtime. I like it but the bugs make it a bit stressful and frudtrating to use when you already hade troubles keeping focus and track of time.
author: Elin Ronja

text: A magnificent tool for keeping me organised and having routines while studying from home. Keeps the anxiety and depression lower because I get more done in a day. Procrastinate less because now I know it only take 3 min empty the dishwasher thank to the time management function. It used to feel like an task as hard as climbing mount everest.
author: Sofia Härnvall

text: I love it. Really easy to use and understand.
author: Marcus Ackre Medina
